For [experimental](/docs/shell/commands/categories/experimental/).

<div class='command-title'>Various commands for working with background jobs.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> job {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input   | output |
| ------- | ------ |
| nothing | string |
## Notes
You must use one of the following subcommands. Using this command as-is will only produce this help message.

## Subcommands:

| name                                             | description                                  | type     |
| ------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| [`job describe`](/docs/shell/commands/job_describe/) | Add a description to a background job.       | built-in |
| [`job flush`](/docs/shell/commands/job_flush/)       | Clear this job's mailbox.                    | built-in |
| [`job id`](/docs/shell/commands/job_id/)             | Get id of current job.                       | built-in |
| [`job kill`](/docs/shell/commands/job_kill/)         | Kill a background job.                       | built-in |
| [`job list`](/docs/shell/commands/job_list/)         | List background jobs.                        | built-in |
| [`job recv`](/docs/shell/commands/job_recv/)         | Read a message from a job's mailbox.         | built-in |
| [`job send`](/docs/shell/commands/job_send/)         | Send a message to the mailbox of a job.      | built-in |
| [`job spawn`](/docs/shell/commands/job_spawn/)       | Spawn a background job and retrieve its ID.  | built-in |
| [`job unfreeze`](/docs/shell/commands/job_unfreeze/) | Unfreeze a frozen process job in foreground. | built-in |
